qualification: 723-family isolated DC proxy only; exact MAA723 identity, transient response, current limiting and connected-stage stress remain open

robotron_pc1715_ic_crossref.use: A separate Robotron PC 1715 service-manual table maps T200/D2000 to SN74H00 and MAA723H to uA723. T200 has matching printed identity in K7222.11, while K7222.11 MAA723 lacks the H suffix; family comparison only.

ti_ua723.use: uA723C comparator: 6.8–7.5 V reference at 25 C, 2.3 mA typical/4 mA maximum standby at 30 V, 9.5–40 V input range, and 150 mA output capability. Behavioral error-amplifier parameters are fitted proxies, not internal specifications.

ti_lm723.use: 10-pin metal-can functional pin contract; 1.7 mA typical standby and 0.2% maximum 1–50 mA load regulation for LM723C at the stated 5 V test fixture. Comparable 723 family, not an MAA723 identification.

m723_ref_v.basis: uA723C reference spread at 25 C; applied as a family proxy, not an MAA723 limit

m723_iq.basis: uA723C 2.3 mA typical/4 mA maximum at 30 V; lower engineering bound is LM723-family 1.7 mA typical

m723_error_gm.basis: behavioral transconductance chosen to reproduce the LM723C 1–50 mA load-regulation class; internal gm not specified

m723_drive_limit.basis: behavioral base-drive bound supporting the uA723 150 mA output class with the provisional pass BJT; not a measured current limit

standby_current_a.conditions: uA723C, 30 V input, no output load, 25 C, family comparison

load_regulation_v.conditions: LM723C 0.2% of 5 V for 1 to 50 mA load, 12 V input, 25 C, family comparison

output_150ma_v.conditions: engineering proxy for uA723 150 mA capability at 12 V input; no 4.9 V data-sheet limit
